සුරාමේරය මජ්ජපමාදට්ඨානා වේරමණී සික්ඛාපදං සමාදියාමි
Surāmēraya majja pamādatthānā vēramanī sikkhāpadam
samādiyāmi
I undertake the precept to refrain from intoxicating drinks and drugs which lead to
carelessness.
බුද්ධ වන්දනා
(Homage to the Buddha)
ඉතිපි සෝ භගවා අරහං සම්මා සම්බුද්ධෝ, විජ්ජාචරණ
සම්පන්නෝ, සුගතෝ ලෝකවිදූ, අනුත්තරෝ පුරිසදම්ම සාරථි,
සත්ථා දේව මනුස්සානං බුද්ධෝ භගවාති.
Itipi so bhagavā arahan, sammā sambuddho, vijjā carana
sampanno,
Such indeed is the blessed one, Exalted, fully enlightened, endowed with clear vision and
virtuous conduct,
sugato, lokavidū, anuttaro purisadhamma sārati,
sublime, the Knower of the worlds, the incomparable leader of men to be tamed,
satthā dēva manussānan, buddho, bagavāti.
the teacher of gods and men, enlightened and blessed.
බුද්ධං ජීවිත පරියන්තං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි.

I go to the Buddha as my refuge to the end of my life.

Yē ca buddhā atītā ca - yē ca buddhā anāgathā
The Buddhas in the past, the Buddhas in the future,
paccuppannā ca yē buddhā - ahan wandāmi sabbadā
the Buddhas in the present, I shall respect you every day.

ඒහිපස්සිකෝ ඕපනයිකෝ, පච්චත්තං වේදිතබ්බෝ
විඤ්ඤූහීති.

ehipassiko, opanayiko, paccattam veditabbo viññūhīti.

ඤායපටිපන්නෝ භගවතෝ සාවක සංඝෝ
සාමීචිපටිපන්නෝ භගවතෝ සාවක සංඝෝ
යදිදං චත්තාරි පුරිස යුගානි, අට්ඨපුරිස පුග්ගලා, ඒස
භගවතෝ සාවක සංඝෝ, ආහුනෙය්‍යෝ පාහුනෙය්‍යෝ,
දක්ඛිණෙය්‍යෝ අඤ්ජලිකරණීය්‍යෝ, අනුත්තරං
පුඤ්ඤක්ඛෙත්තං ලෝකස්සාති.
Supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka sangho.
Of good conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Ujupaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka sangho.
Of upright conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Ñāyapaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka sangho.
Of wise conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Sāmīcipaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka sangho.
Of gentle conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.

pali_si: නත්ථී මේ සරණං අඤ්ඤං - ධම්මෝ මේ සරණං වරං
ඒතේන සච්ච වජ්ජේන - හෝතු මේ ජය මංගලං
roman: Natthi mē saranan aññan - dhammo mē saranan waran
ētēna sacca wajjēna - hotu mē jayamangalan
english: For me there is no other refuge, the Dhamma is my matchless refuge;
by the power of these words of truth, may joyous victory be mine.

pali_si: උත්තමංගේන වන්දේහං - ධම්මං ච තිවිධං වරං
ධම්මේ යෝ ඛලිතෝ දෝසෝ - ධම්මෝ ඛමතු තං මමං
roman: dhammē yo kalitho doso - dhammañca tividan waran
english: With my forehead I pay reverence, to the matchless threefold Dhamma,
if I have done wrong to the Dhamma,  may the Dhamma forgive me.

pali_si: යදිදං චත්තාරි පුරිස යුගානි, අට්ඨපුරිස පුග්ගලා, ඒස
english: Of good conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Of upright conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Of wise conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.
Of gentle conduct is the disciples of the blessed one.

lines.text: Yadidam cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisa puggalā,
these four pairs of persons, the eight kinds of individuals
ēsa Bhagavato sāvaka sangho;
The disciples of the blessed one
āhuneyyo, pāhuneyyo, dakkhineyyo, anjalikaranīyo,
are worthy of gifts, Worthy of hospitality, Worthy of offerings, Worthy of respect;
anuttaram puññakkhettan lokassā ti.
is an incomparable field of merit to the world.
සංඝං ජීවිත පරියන්තං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි.
Sanghan jīvita pariyantan saranan gacchāmi
I go to the Sangha as my refuge to the end of my life.
යේ ච සංඝා අතීතා ච - යේ ච සංඝා අනාගතා
පච්චුප්පන්නා ච යේ සංඝා - අහං වන්දාමි සබ්බදා
Yē ca sanghā atītā ca - yē ca sanghā anāgatā
The Noble disciples in the past, the noble disciples in the future,
paccuppannā ca yē sanghā - ahan wandāmi sabbadā
the noble disciples in the present, I shall respect you every day.
නත්ථී මේ සරණං අඤ්ඤං - සංඝෝ මේ සරණං වරං
ඒතේන සච්ච වජ්ජේන - හෝතු මේ ජය මංගලං
Natthi mē saranan aññan - sanghō mē saranan waran
For me there is no other refuge, the Sangha is my matchless refuge;
ētēna sacca wajjēna - hotu mē jayamangalan
by the power if these words, may joyous victory be mine.
උත්තමංගේන වන්දේහං - සංඝං ච තිවිධෝත්තමං
සංඝේ යෝ ඛලිතෝ දෝසෝ - සංඝෝ ඛමතු තං මමං
uttamangēna wandēhan - sanghañca tividottaman
With my forehead I pay reverence, to the matchless threefold Sangha,
sanghē yo kalitho doso - sangho khamatu tan maman.
If I have wronged by mistake, may the Sangha forgive me.

roman: Yadidam cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisa puggalā,
english: these four pairs of persons, the eight kinds of individuals
The disciples of the blessed one
are worthy of gifts, Worthy of hospitality, Worthy of offerings, Worthy of respect;
is an incomparable field of merit to the world.
I go to the Sangha as my refuge to the end of my life.

pali_si: යේ ච සංඝා අතීතා ච - යේ ච සංඝා අනාගතා
පච්චුප්පන්නා ච යේ සංඝා - අහං වන්දාමි සබ්බදා
roman: Yē ca sanghā atītā ca - yē ca sanghā anāgatā
paccuppannā ca yē sanghā - ahan wandāmi sabbadā
english: The Noble disciples in the past, the noble disciples in the future,
the noble disciples in the present, I shall respect you every day.

pali_si: නත්ථී මේ සරණං අඤ්ඤං - සංඝෝ මේ සරණං වරං
ඒතේන සච්ච වජ්ජේන - හෝතු මේ ජය මංගලං
roman: Natthi mē saranan aññan - sanghō mē saranan waran
ētēna sacca wajjēna - hotu mē jayamangalan
english: For me there is no other refuge, the Sangha is my matchless refuge;
by the power if these words, may joyous victory be mine.

pali_si: සංඝේ යෝ ඛලිතෝ දෝසෝ - සංඝෝ ඛමතු තං මමං
roman: sanghē yo kalitho doso - sangho khamatu tan maman.
english: With my forehead I pay reverence, to the matchless threefold Sangha,
If I have wronged by mistake, may the Sangha forgive me.

lines.text: සියල්ල එකට සිහි කිරීම
බුද්ධ ධම්මා ච පච්චේක - බුද්ධ සංඝා ච සාමිකා
දාසෝවා හස්මි මේතේසං - ගුණං ඨාතු සිරේ සදා
Buddha dhamma ca paccēka - buddha sangha ca sāmikā
The buddha, the Dhamma, the private Buddhas and the Sangha are my lords;
Dasova hasmi mētēsan - gunan thātu sirē sadā
and I am their servant. May I recollect their excellence.
තිසරණං තිලක්ඛණූපේතං - නිබ්බාණමන්තිමං සුඛං
සුවන්දේ සිරසා නිච්චං - ලබාමි තිවිධාමහං
Tisaranan tilakkhanūpētan - nibbāna mantiman sukhan
The three refuges, imbued with three signs, Nibbana the ultimate happiness,
Suwandē sirasā niccan - labhāmi tividhāmahan
I always revere them; may I gain the threefold happiness.
තිසරණං ච සිරේ ඨාතු - සිරේ ඨාතු තිලක්ඛණං
උපෙක්ඛා ච සිරේ ඨාතු - නිබ්බාණං ඨාතු මේ සිරේ
Tisaranañca sire thātu - sirē thātu tilakkhanan
May the three refuges be on my head - and may the three signs be on my head,
Upekkhā ca sirē thātu - nibbānan thātu mē sire
May the may equanimity be on my head, - and may the Nibbana so be on my head.
බුද්ධේ සකරුණේ වන්දේ - ධම්මේ පච්චේක සම්බුද්ධේ
සංඝේච සිරසායේව - තිධානිච්ච නමාමහං
Buddhē sakarunē vandē - dhammē paccēka sambuddhē
homage to the compassionate Buddha, -  to the Dhamma, to the private buddhas;
Sanghē ca sirasāyēwa - Tidhā nicca namāmahan
And to the Sangha, with my forehead - I always pay threefold reverence.

pali_si: බුද්ධ ධම්මා ච පච්චේක - බුද්ධ සංඝා ච සාමිකා
දාසෝවා හස්මි මේතේසං - ගුණං ඨාතු සිරේ සදා
roman: Buddha dhamma ca paccēka - buddha sangha ca sāmikā
Dasova hasmi mētēsan - gunan thātu sirē sadā
english: The buddha, the Dhamma, the private Buddhas and the Sangha are my lords;
and I am their servant. May I recollect their excellence.
The three refuges, imbued with three signs, Nibbana the ultimate happiness,
I always revere them; may I gain the threefold happiness.

pali_si: තිසරණං ච සිරේ ඨාතු - සිරේ ඨාතු තිලක්ඛණං
උපෙක්ඛා ච සිරේ ඨාතු - නිබ්බාණං ඨාතු මේ සිරේ
roman: Tisaranañca sire thātu - sirē thātu tilakkhanan
Upekkhā ca sirē thātu - nibbānan thātu mē sire
english: May the three refuges be on my head - and may the three signs be on my head,
May the may equanimity be on my head, - and may the Nibbana so be on my head.

pali_si: බුද්ධේ සකරුණේ වන්දේ - ධම්මේ පච්චේක සම්බුද්ධේ
roman: Buddhē sakarunē vandē - dhammē paccēka sambuddhē
Sanghē ca sirasāyēwa - Tidhā nicca namāmahan
english: homage to the compassionate Buddha, -  to the Dhamma, to the private buddhas;
And to the Sangha, with my forehead - I always pay threefold reverence.

lines.text: නමාමි සත්ථුනෝවාද - අප්පමාද වචනන්තිමං
සබ්බේපි චේතියේ වන්දේ - උපජ්ඣාචරියේ මමං
මය්හං පනාම තේජේන - චිත්තං පාපේහි මුඤ්චිතංති.
Namāmi satthunovāda - appamāda vacanantiman
Homage to the teachings of the Buddha, - to earnestness the last exhortation,
Sabbēpi cētiyē vandē - upajjācariyē maman
to all the shrines, -  to my preceptors and teachers
Mayihanpanāma tējēna - cittan papēhi muñcitan.
By dint of this salutation, - may my mind be free from evil.
නමාමි බුද්ධං ගුණසාගරන්තං
සත්තා සදා හොන්තු සුඛී අවේරා
කායෝ ජිගුච්ඡෝ සකලෝ දුගන්ධෝ
ගච්ඡන්ති සබ්බේ මරණං අහං ච
Namāmi Buddhan guṇa sāgarantan
I worship the Buddha, the ocean of virtues.
Sattā sadā hontu sukhī avērā
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
Kāyo jiguccho sakalo dugandho
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
Gacchanti sabbe maraṇaṃ ahañ ca
All beings, including myself must die.
නමාමි ධම්මං සුගතේන දේසිතං
සත්තා සදා හොන්තු සුඛී අවේරා
කායෝ ජිගුච්ඡෝ සකලෝ දුගන්ධෝ
ගච්ඡන්ති සබ්බේ මරණං අහං ච
Namāmi Dhamman sugatēna dēsitan
Homage to the Dhamma, preached by the Buddha.
Sattā sadā hontu sukhī avērā
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
Kāyo jiguccho sakalo dugandho
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
Gacchanti sabbe maraṇaṃ ahañ ca
All beings, including myself must die.

pali_si: මය්හං පනාම තේජේන - චිත්තං පාපේහි මුඤ්චිතංති.
english: Homage to the teachings of the Buddha, - to earnestness the last exhortation,
to all the shrines, -  to my preceptors and teachers
By dint of this salutation, - may my mind be free from evil.
I worship the Buddha, the ocean of virtues.
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
All beings, including myself must die.
Homage to the Dhamma, preached by the Buddha.
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
All beings, including myself must die.

lines.text: නමාමි සංඝං මුනිරාජ සාවකං
සත්තා සදා හොන්තු සුඛී අවේරා
කායෝ ජිගුච්ඡෝ සකලෝ දුගන්ධෝ
ගච්ඡන්ති සබ්බේ මරණං අහං ච
Namāmi Sanghan Munirāja sāvakan
Homage to the Saṅgha, the disciples of the Buddha
Sattā sadā hontu sukhī avērā
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
Kāyo jiguccho sakalo dugandho
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
Gacchanti sabbe maraṇaṃ ahañ ca
All beings, including myself must die.
ත්‍රිවිධ චෛත්‍ය වන්දනාව
Homage to the three main objects of veneration
වන්දාමි චේතියං සබ්බං - සබ්බ ඨානේසු පතිට්ඨිතං
සාරීරික ධාතු මහා බෝධිං - බුද්ධ රූපං සකලං සදා
Vandāmi cētiyan sabban - Sabbaṭhānēsu patiṭṭhitan
I pay reverence to every shrine that may stand in any place
Sārīrikadhātu Mahā Bodhin - Buddharūpan sakalan sadā
the bodily relics, the Bodhi tree,  and all statues of the Buddha.
බෝධි වන්දනය
lines.heading_en: Homage to the noble Bodhi Tree

lines.text: යස්ස මූලේ නිසින්නෝව - සබ්බාරි විජයං අකා
පත්තෝ සබ්බඤ්ඤුතං සත්ථා - වන්දේ තං බෝධි පාදපං
Yassa mūlē nisinnova - Sabbāri vijayan akā
Seated at whose base, the Buddha overcame all foes,
Patto sabbaññutan satthā - Vandē tan Bodhi pādapan
attained omniscience; I pay my respect to that very Bodhi Tree.
ඉමේ ඒතේ මහා බෝධි - ලෝක නාථේන පූජිතා
අහංපි තේ නමස්සාමි - බෝධි රාජා නමත්ථු තේ

english: Homage to the Saṅgha, the disciples of the Buddha
May all beings be happy and free from enmity.
The body is repulsive and full of bad smell.
All beings, including myself must die.

pali_si: වන්දාමි චේතියං සබ්බං - සබ්බ ඨානේසු පතිට්ඨිතං
සාරීරික ධාතු මහා බෝධිං - බුද්ධ රූපං සකලං සදා
roman: Sārīrikadhātu Mahā Bodhin - Buddharūpan sakalan sadā
english: I pay reverence to every shrine that may stand in any place
the bodily relics, the Bodhi tree,  and all statues of the Buddha.

lines.text: Imē ētē mahā Bodhi - Loka nāthēna pūjitā
These great Bodhi trees, venerated by the Buddha, (the conqueror of the world)
Ahaṃpi tē namassāmi - Bodhirājā namatthu tē.
I too, shall respect you; May my homage be to you — O, Great Bodhi Tree.
ආමිස පූජා
(Only chant verses for what you are offering)
පහන් පූජාව
ඝණසාරප්පදිත්තේන - දීපේන තමධංසිනා
තිලෝක දීපං සම්බුද්ධං - පූජයාමි තමෝනුදං
Ghanasārappa dittēna - Dīpēna tamadhansinā
With brightly shining light, gloom is abolished.
Tilokadīpan sambuddhan - Pūjayāmi tamonudan
I revere the Buddha, the light of the three worlds, who dispels the darkness of ignorance.
සුවඳ දුම් පූජාව
සුගන්ධිකාය වදනං - අනන්ත ගුණගන්ධිනා
සුගන්ධිනාහං ගන්ධේන - පූජයාමි තථාගතං
Sugandikāya vadanan - Ananta gunagandinā
fragrant of face and form, Perfumed with infinite qualities,
Sugandināhan gandēna - pūjayāmi tathāgatan.
with incense, sweet and penetrating, I revere the Tathagatha.
මල් පූජාව
වණ්ණගන්ධ ගුණෝපේතං - ඒතං කුසුම සන්තතිං
පූජයාමි මුනින්දස්ස - සිරීපාද සරෝරුහේ
Vaṇṇagandha guṇopētan - ētan Kusuma santatin
fresh-hued and fragrant, this spread of flowers,
Pūjayāmi munindassa - Sirīpāda saroruhē
I offer at the sacred lotus Feet of the Noble Sage.

මොක්ඛං
පුප්ඵං මිලායාති යථා ඉදං මේ - කායෝ තථා යාති විනාස භාවං

Just as these flowers fade, so my body too will pass away.

All the merits, thus, accumulated by us,
Sabbe dēva anumōdantu - sabba sampatti siddhiya.
May all the Devas share, For the acquisition of all kinds of happiness and prosperity.

lines.text: Addhāya imāya patipattiyā jāti jarā vyādhi maranamhā
parimuncissāmi
Actually, by living in this practice, I will free from birth, aging, illness and death, etc.
ඉදං මේ පුඤ්ඤකම්මං ආසවක්ඛයාවහං හෝතු සබ්බ දුක්ඛා
පමුඤ්චතු.
Idam mē puñña kamman, āsavakkhayāvahan hōtu, sabba
dukkhā pamuñcatu.
May this merit help to remove the defilements; may I be free from all sufferings.
බුද්ධානුස්සතිය
බුද්ධානුස්සති මෙත්තා ච -  අසුභං මරණස්සති
ඉති ඉමා චතුරාරක්ඛා - භික්ඛු භාවෙය්‍ය සීලවා
Buddhānussati mettā ca - asubhan maranassati
The recollection of the Buddha, loving kindness, the unattractiveness (of the body) and
mindfulness of death,
Iti imā caturārakkhā - bhikkhu bhāveyya sīlavā
these are the four protective meditations which a virtuous monk should develop.
අනන්ත විත්තාර ගුණං - ගුණතෝනුස්සරං මුනිං

Ananta vittāra gunan - gunatorussaran munin
Contemplating the infinite and extensive excellent qualities of the Buddha,
Bhāveyya buddhimā bhikkhu - Buddhānussati mādito
An intelligent monk, first, should develop the recollection of the Buddha as follows;
සවාසනේ කිලේසේසෝ - ඒකෝ සබ්බේ නිඝාතිය
අහූසු සුද්ධසන්තානෝ - පූජානං ච සදාරහෝ
Savāsanē kilēsēso - eko sabbē nighātiya
He alone destroyed all the defilements together with the residual kammic impressions.
ahūsu suddha santāno - pūjānañ ca sadāraho
His mind is fully purified, and He, always, is worthy of offerings.

සබ්බාකාරේන බුජ්⟦ˉ⟧ත්වා - ඒකෝ සබ්බඤ්ඤුතං ගතෝ
Sabbakāla gathē dhammē - sabbē sammā sayan muni
The Buddha has perfectly realised all phenomena related to all three times.
sabbākārēna bujjhitvā - eko sabbaññutan gatho
Having realised in every aspect, alone by himself, attained the Omniscience.
විපස්සනාදි විජ්ජාහි - සීලාදි චරණේහි ච
සුසමිද්ධේහි සම්පන්නෝ - ගගනාභේහි නායකෝ
Vipassanādi vijjāhi - sīlādi caranēhi ca
Accomplishments of the knowledge (eight-fold) such as insight and conduct (fifteen-fold) as
virtue,
Susamiddhēhi sampanno - gaganābhēhi nāyako
These are the qualities He is endowed with and he is as bright as the sun in the sky.
සම්මාගතෝ සුභං ඨානං - අමෝඝ වචනෝ ච සෝ
තිවිධස්සාපි ලෝකස්ස - ඤාතා නිරවසේසතෝ
Sammāgato subhan thānan - amoga vacano ca so
He perfectly attained to the blissfull state (Nibbana), and his words are accurate and
fruitful.
Tividassāpi lokassa - ñātā niravasēsato
He is the one who knows the three worlds in entirety.
අනේකේහි ගුණෝඝේහි - සබ්බසත්තුත්තමෝ අහූ
අනේකේහි උපායේහි - නරදම්මේ දමේසි ච

By innumerable ocean of qualities, he became supreme of all beings,
Anēkēhi upāyēhi - naradhamme damēsi ca
by various means He tamed the tameable ones.
ඒකෝ සබ්බස්ස ලෝකස්ස - සබ්බ සත්තානුසාසකෝ

He is the supreme repository for the qualities such as fortune and prosperity.
පඤ්ඤාස්ස සබ්බ ධම්මේසු - කරුණා සබ්බ ජන්තුසු
අත්තත්තානං පරත්තානං - සාධිකා ගුණජෙට්ඨිකා
Paññāssa sabba dhammēsu - karunā sabba jantusu
His wisdom in all the phenomena, and compassion towards all beings -
Atthatthānan paratthānan - sādhikā guna jetthikā
are the main qualities that benefit one and others.
දයාය පාරමී චිත්වා - පඤ්ඤායත්තාන මුද්ධරි
උද්ධරි සබ්බ ධම්මේ ච - දයායඤ්ඤේ ච උද්ධරි
Dayāya pārami citvā - paññāyattana muddhari
He has cultivated perfections out of compassion and has liberated himself through wisdom;
Uddhari sabba dhammē ca - dayāyaññē ca uddhari
By preaching the doctrine, in all aspects, out of compassion,  rescued others.
දිස්සමානෝපි තාවස්ස - රූපකායෝ අචින්තියෝ
අසාධාරණ ඤාණඩ්ඩේ - ධම්මකායේ කතාවකාති.
Dissamānopi tāvassa - rūpakāyo acintiyo
Though visible, his Rupa Kaya (physical body) was inconceivable.
asādhārana ñānaddhē - dhamma kāyē kathāvakāti.
So, what can be said about His Dhamma Kaya (Doctrinal body), enriched with his unique
wisdom.
මෙත්තානුස්සතිය
(Recollection on loving kindness)
අත්තූපමාය සබ්බේසං - සත්තානං සුඛකාමතං
පස්සිත්වා ඛමතෝ මෙත්තං - සබ්බ සත්තේසු භාවයේ

english: He is the unique adviser in every aspect of welfare for the entire world.
He is the supreme repository for the qualities such as fortune and prosperity.

lines.text: Attūpamāya sabbēsan - sattānan sukhakhāmatan
Having compared oneself with others, have a desire for the happiness of all living
beings.
Passitvā khamato mettan - sabba sattēsu bhāvayē
Having seen it, one should develop loving kindness towards all living beings.
සුඛී භවෙය්‍යං නිද්දුක්ඛෝ - අහං නිච්චං අහං විය
හිතා ච මේ සුඛී හොන්තු - මජ්ඣත්තා තච වේරිනෝ
Sukhī bhaveyyan niddhukkho - ahan niccan ahan viya
May I always be happy and free from suffering and like myself,
Hitā ca mē sukhī hontu - majjatthā thaca vērino
may my friends, neutral persons and hostile persons always be happy.
ඉමම්හි ගාමක්ඛෙත්තම්හි - සත්තා හොන්තු සුඛී සදා
තතෝ පරඤ්ච රජ්ජේසු - චක්කවාලේසු ජන්තුනෝ
Imamhi gāmakkettamhi - sattā hontu sukhī sadā
may the beings in this village, vicinity always be happy
tato parañ ca rajjēsu - cakkavālēsu jantuno
and those who live in other countries and the ones who live in all the world systems, be well
and happy.
සමන්තා චක්කවාලේසු - සත්තානන්තේසු පානිනෝ
සුඛිනෝ පුග්ගලා භූතා - අත්තභාවගතා සියුං
samantā cakkavālēsu - sattānantēsu panino
Those living in the infinite surrounding world systems, all persons
sukhino puggalā bhūtā - attabhāva gatā siyun
creatures and all living beings be well and happy;
තථා ඉත්ථී පුමා චේව - අරියා අනරියාපි ච
දේවා නරා අපායට්ඨා - තථා දසදිසාසු චාති
tathā itthi pumā cēva - ariyā anariyāpi ca
likewise, female, male, noble ones, ignoble ones,
dēvā narā apāyatthā - tathā dasa disāsu cāti
gods, humans, the ones in woeful states, and all those in the ten directions be well and happy.

english: Having compared oneself with others, have a desire for the happiness of all living
beings.
Having seen it, one should develop loving kindness towards all living beings.

lines.text: අසුභානුස්සතිය
(Recollection on the unattractiveness of the body)
අවිඤ්ඤාණසුභනිභං - සවිඤ්ඤාණ සුභං ඉමං
කායං අසුභතෝ පස්සං - අසුභං භාවයේ සති
Aviññāna subhaniban - saviññana subhan iman
Seeing the body unattractive with both with and without the consciousness,
Kāyan asubhato passan - asubhan bhāvayē sati
a meditator should reflect (meditate) on the loathsomeness of the body.
වණ්ණසණ්ඨාන ගන්ධේහි - ආසයෝ කාසතෝ තථා
පටික්කූලානි කායේ මේ - කුණපානි ද්විසෝලස
Vanna santāna gandhēhi - āsayo kāsato tathā
By way of their colour, shape, smell, associated location space and appearance;
patikkūlāni kāyē mē - kunapānidvisolasa
The thirty-two parts of the body are repulsive
පතිතම්හාපි කුණපා - ජෙගුච්ඡං කායනිස්සිතං
ආධාරෝහි සුචී තස්ස - කායේතු කුණපේ ඨිතං
Patitamhāpi kunapā - jēgucchan kāya nissitan
The impurities that are still remaining in the body are more disgusting than the ones which
have fallen down.
Ādhārohi sucī tassa - kāyētu kunapē thitan
because the place upon where they have been fallen down is pure, but when they are in the
body those impurities are in a foul body.
මීල්හේ කිමිව කායෝයං - අසුචිම්හි සමුට්ඨිතෝ
අන්තෝ අසුචි සම්පුන්නෝ - පුණ්ණවච්චකුටී විය
Mīlhē kimiva kāyoyan - asucimhi samitthito
Just like a worm that is born in the filth, this body also is born in the filth.
Anto asuci sampunno - punna vaccakutī viya
This body is full of filth like a cesspit full of filth.
අසුචි සන්දතේ නිච්චං - යථා මේදකථාලිකා
නානාකිමි කුලාවාසෝ - පක්ඛචන්දනිකා විය

units.heading: අසුභානුස්සතිය
notes: (Recollection on the unattractiveness of the body)

lines.text: Asuci sandatē niccan - yathā mēdakathālikā
Impure matters always flow out from this body constantly just like fat from a clay-pot when
it is full.
Nānākimi kulāvāso - pakkacandanikā viya
Just like a cesspool, this body is the home for various kinds of worms.
ගණ්ඩභූතෝ රෝගභූතෝ - වණභූතෝ සමුස්සයෝ
අතේකිච්ඡෝති ජේගුච්ඡෝ - පභින්නකුණපූපමෝති
Gandabhūto rogabhūto - vanabhūto samussayo
This body is like a boil, a disease, an incurable wound,
Atēkicchoti gēguccho - Pabhinna kunapūpamoti.
Extremely, repulsive and fragile. It is comparable to a decomposed corpse.
මරණානුස්සතිය
(Recollection on death)
පවාතදීප තුල්‍යාය - සායුසන්ත තියාක්කයං
පරූපමාය සම්පස්සං - භාවයේ මරණස්සති
Pavāta dīpa tulyāya - sāyu santa tiyākkhayan
Seeing with wisdom, the end of life in others and comparing this to a lamp
Parūpamāya sampassan - bhāvayē maranassati
Kept in windy place, one should meditate on death.
මහා සම්පත්ති සම්පත්තා - යථා සත්තා මතා ඉධ
තථා අහං මරිස්සාමි - මරණං මම හෙස්සති
Mahāsampatti sampattā - yathā sattā matā idha
Just as persons in this world who achieved great wealth and success have passed away,
Tathā ahan marissāmi - maranan mama hessati
the same way I too will die.  For sure, the death will come to me.
උප්පත්තියා සහේවේදං - මරණං ආගතං සදා
මරණත්තාය ඕකාසං - වධකෝ විය ඒසති
Uppattiyā sahē vēdan - maranan āgatan sadā
The death always comes alone, together with birth,
Maranattāya okāsan - vadako viya ēsati
looking for an opportunity, as an executioner would do.

it is full.
Just like a cesspool, this body is the home for various kinds of worms.
This body is like a boil, a disease, an incurable wound,
Extremely, repulsive and fragile. It is comparable to a decomposed corpse.

තථා අහං මරිස්සාමි - මරණං මම හෙස්සති

lines.text: ඊසකං අනිවත්තන්තං - සතතං ගමනුස්සුකං
ජීවිතං උදයා අත්ථං - සුරියෝ විය ධාවති
Īsakan anivattantan - satatan gamanussukan
The life, without stopping even for a moment, and ever keen on moving,
Jīvitan udayā atthan - suriyo viya dhāvati
Runs like the sun that hastens to set after its rise.
විජ්ජුබුබ්බුල උස්සාව - ජලරාජී පරික්ඛයං
ඝාතකෝව රිපූතස්ස - සබ්බත්ථාපි අවාරියෝ
Vijju bubbula ussāva - jalarāji parikkhayan
This life is fragile, like a lightning, a bubble, a dew drop on a leaf or a line drawn on the water.
Ghātakova ripūtassa - sabbatthāpi avāriyo
Like an enemy intent on killing, death can never be avoided.
සුයසත්තාම පුඤ්ඤිද්ධි - බුද්ධිවුද්ධි ජිනද්වයං
ඝාතේසි මරණං ඛිප්පං - කාතුමාදිසකේ කථා
Suyasatthāma puññiddhi - buddhivuddhi jinaddvayan
If the Death quickly killed the conqueror (The Buddha), who possessed great fame, strength,
Ghātēsi maranan khippan - kātu mādisakē kata?
merit and supernatural powers. What can be said of one like me?
පච්චයානඤ්ච වේකල්‍යා - බාහිරජ්ඣත්තුපද්දවා
මරාමෝරං නිමේසාපි - මරමානෝ අනුක්ඛනන්ති
Paccayānañca vēkalyā – bāhirajjattupaddavā
When there is a deficiency in conditions for life or some inner or outer danger
Marāmoran nimēsāpi - maranāno anukkhananti.
I would die at any moment within a blink of an eye.

pali_si: ජීවිතං උදයා අත්ථං - සුරියෝ විය ධාවති
roman: Jīvitan udayā atthan - suriyo viya dhāvati
english: The life, without stopping even for a moment, and ever keen on moving,
Runs like the sun that hastens to set after its rise.
This life is fragile, like a lightning, a bubble, a dew drop on a leaf or a line drawn on the water.
Like an enemy intent on killing, death can never be avoided.

roman: Ghātēsi maranan khippan - kātu mādisakē kata?
english: If the Death quickly killed the conqueror (The Buddha), who possessed great fame, strength,
merit and supernatural powers. What can be said of one like me?
When there is a deficiency in conditions for life or some inner or outer danger
I would die at any moment within a blink of an eye.

lines.text: අට්ඨ මහා සංවේග වත්ථු
(recollection of eight sorrowful stages of life)
භාවෙත්වා චතුරාරක්ඛා - ආවජ්ජෙය්‍ය අනන්තරං
මහා සංවේග වත්ථූනි - අට්ඨ අට්ඨිත වීරියෝ
Bhāvetvā caturārakkhā - āvajjeyya anantaran
Having developed four protective meditations,
Mahā sanvēga vatthūni - attha atthita vīriyo
the diligent meditator, thereafter, should contemplate on eight-fold miseries.
ජාති ජරා ව්‍යාධි ච්‍යුති අපායා - අතීත අප්පත්තක වට්ට දුක්ඛං
ඉදානි ආහාර ගවෙට්ඨි දුක්ඛං - සංවේග වත්ථූනි ඉමානි අට්ඨ
Jāti jarā vyadhi cyuti apāyā - atīta appattaka vatta dukkhan
Birth, old age, illness, death, miseries underwent in the hells, miseries underwent in the past
lives, miseries yet to come in the future lives
Idāni āhāra gavetthi dukkhan - sanvēga vatthūni imāni attha.
and miseries experience in the present life are called eight-fold miseries.
පාතෝ ච සායමපිචේව ඉමං විධිඤ්ඤෝ
ආසේවතේ සතතමත්ත හිතාභිලාසි
පප්පෝති සෝති විපුලං හත පාරිපන්ථෝ
සෙට්ඨං සුඛං මුනි විසිට්ඨමතං සුඛේනචාති
Pāto ca sāya mapicēva iman vidhiñño
If a person, wishing one’s own wellbeing or liberation,
Āsēvatē satatamatta hitābhilāsī
contemplate on these always in the morning and evening,
Pappoti soti vipulan hata pāri panto
he accomplishes his greatest happiness in this very life
Setthan sukhan muni visitthamatan sukhēnacāti.
and attains the supreme bliss of Nibbana praised by the Buddhas.

units.heading: අට්ඨ මහා සංවේග වත්ථු
notes: (recollection of eight sorrowful stages of life)

pali_si: මහා සංවේග වත්ථූනි - අට්ඨ අට්ඨිත වීරියෝ
roman: Mahā sanvēga vatthūni - attha atthita vīriyo
english: Having developed four protective meditations,
the diligent meditator, thereafter, should contemplate on eight-fold miseries.

pali_si: ජාති ජරා ව්‍යාධි ච්‍යුති අපායා - අතීත අප්පත්තක වට්ට දුක්ඛං
ඉදානි ආහාර ගවෙට්ඨි දුක්ඛං - සංවේග වත්ථූනි ඉමානි අට්ඨ
roman: Jāti jarā vyadhi cyuti apāyā - atīta appattaka vatta dukkhan
Idāni āhāra gavetthi dukkhan - sanvēga vatthūni imāni attha.
english: Birth, old age, illness, death, miseries underwent in the hells, miseries underwent in the past
lives, miseries yet to come in the future lives
and miseries experience in the present life are called eight-fold miseries.

roman: Pāto ca sāya mapicēva iman vidhiñño
Pappoti soti vipulan hata pāri panto
english: If a person, wishing one’s own wellbeing or liberation,
contemplate on these always in the morning and evening,
he accomplishes his greatest happiness in this very life
and attains the supreme bliss of Nibbana praised by the Buddhas.

lines.text: පටිච්ච සමුප්පාදය
අනුලෝම
අවිජ්ජා පච්චයා සංඛාරා, සංඛාර පච්චයා විඤ්ඤාණං,
විඤ්ඤාණ පච්චයා නාමරූපං, නාමරූප පච්චයා සලායතනං,
සලායතන පච්චයා ඵස්සෝ, ඵස්ස පච්චයා වේදනා, වේදනා
පච්චයා තණ්හා, තණ්හා පච්චයා උපාදානං, උපාදාන පච්චයා
භවෝ, භව පච්චයා ජාති,  ජාති පච්චයා ජරා මරණං, සෝක
පරිදේව දුක්ඛ දෝමනස්සුපායාසා සම්භවන්ති. ඒවමේතස්ස
කේවලස්ස දුක්ඛක්ඛන්ධස්ස සමුදයෝ හෝතීති.
Avijjāpaccayā sankhārā, Sankhāra paccayā viññāṇan,
Dependent on ignorance arise volitional activities (moral and immoral), Dependent on
volitional activities arises consciousness,
Viññāṇa paccayā nāma-rūpan, Nāma-rūpa paccayā
saḷāyatanan,
Dependent on consciousness arise mind and matter, Dependent on mind and matter arise
the six spheres of sense,
Saḷāyatana paccayā phasso, Phassa paccayā vēdanā, Vēdanā
paccayā taṇhā,
Dependent on six spheres of sense arises contact, Dependent on contact arises sensation,
Dependent on sensation
Taṇhā paccayā upādānan, Upādāna paccayā bhavo, Bhava
arises craving, Dependent on craving arises grasping, Dependent on grasping arises becoming,
Dependent on
paccayā jāti, Jāti paccayā jarā maraṇan, Soka paridēva,
dukkha domanassupāyāsā
becoming arises birth, Dependent on birth arises decay, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain,
sambhavanti, Ēvamētassa kēvalassa, dukkhakkhandhassa,
samudayo hoti’ti.
grief and despair; Thus, the entire mass of suffering arises.

pali_si: අවිජ්ජා පච්චයා සංඛාරා, සංඛාර පච්චයා විඤ්ඤාණං,
විඤ්ඤාණ පච්චයා නාමරූපං, නාමරූප පච්චයා සලායතනං,
සලායතන පච්චයා ඵස්සෝ, ඵස්ස පච්චයා වේදනා, වේදනා
පච්චයා තණ්හා, තණ්හා පච්චයා උපාදානං, උපාදාන පච්චයා
භවෝ, භව පච්චයා ජාති,  ජාති පච්චයා ජරා මරණං, සෝක
roman: Saḷāyatana paccayā phasso, Phassa paccayā vēdanā, Vēdanā
Taṇhā paccayā upādānan, Upādāna paccayā bhavo, Bhava
paccayā jāti, Jāti paccayā jarā maraṇan, Soka paridēva,
english: Dependent on ignorance arise volitional activities (moral and immoral), Dependent on
volitional activities arises consciousness,
Dependent on consciousness arise mind and matter, Dependent on mind and matter arise
the six spheres of sense,
Dependent on six spheres of sense arises contact, Dependent on contact arises sensation,
Dependent on sensation
arises craving, Dependent on craving arises grasping, Dependent on grasping arises becoming,
Dependent on
becoming arises birth, Dependent on birth arises decay, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain,
grief and despair; Thus, the entire mass of suffering arises.

lines.text: පටිලෝම
අවිජ්ජායත්වේව අසේස විරාග නිරෝධා සංඛාර නිරෝධෝ,
සංඛාර නිරෝධා විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධෝ, විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධා
නාමරූප නිරෝධෝ, නාමරූප නිරෝධා සලායතන නිරෝධෝ,
සලායතන නිරෝධා ඵස්ස නිරෝධෝ, ඵස්ස නිරෝධා වේදනා
නිරෝධෝ, වේදනා නිරෝධා තණ්හා නිරෝධෝ, තණ්හා
නිරෝධා උපාදාන නිරෝධෝ, උපාදාන නිරෝධා භව නිරෝධෝ,
භව නිරෝධා ජාති නිරෝධෝ,  ජාති නිරෝධා ජරා මරණං,
සෝක පරිදේව දුක්ඛ දෝමනස්සුපායාසා නිරුජ්ඣන්ති.
ඒවමේතස්ස කේවලස්ස දුක්ඛක්ඛන්ධස්ස නිරෝධෝ හෝතීති.
Avijjāyatvēva asēsa virāga nirodhā saṅkhāra nirodho,
The complete cessation of ignorance leads to the cessation of volitional activities. The
cessation of volitional
Saṅkhāra nirodhā viññaṇa nirodho, Viññāṇa nirodhā nāma-
rūpa nirodho,
activities lead to the cessation of consciousness. The cessation of consciousness leads to the
cessation of mind and matter.
Nāma- rūpa nirodhā saḷāyatana nirodho, Saḷāyatana nirodhā
phassa nirodho,
The cessation of mind and matter leads to the cessation of six spheres of sense.
Phassa nirodhā vēdanā nirodho, Vēdanā nirodhā tanhā
nirodho,
The cessation of six spheres of sense leads to the cessation of contact. The cessation of
contact leads to the cessation of sensation.
Taṇhā nirodhā upādāna nirodho, Upādāna nirodhā bhava
nirodho,
The cessation of sensation leads to the cessation of craving. The cessation of craving leads -
Bhava nirodhā jāti nirodho, Jāti nirodhā jarā maraṇaṃ, soka
paridēva,
to the cessation of grasping. The cessation of grasping leads to the cessation of becoming.
The cessation of becoming -
dukkha domanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti. Ēvamētassa
kēvalassa,
leads to the cessation of birth. The cessation of birth leads to the cessation of decay, death,
dukkhakkhandassa nirodho hoti’ti.
sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief and despair. Thus, entire mass of suffering ceases.

pali_si: අවිජ්ජායත්වේව අසේස විරාග නිරෝධා සංඛාර නිරෝධෝ,
සංඛාර නිරෝධා විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධෝ, විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධා
නාමරූප නිරෝධෝ, නාමරූප නිරෝධා සලායතන නිරෝධෝ,
සලායතන නිරෝධා ඵස්ස නිරෝධෝ, ඵස්ස නිරෝධා වේදනා
නිරෝධෝ, වේදනා නිරෝධා තණ්හා නිරෝධෝ, තණ්හා
නිරෝධා උපාදාන නිරෝධෝ, උපාදාන නිරෝධා භව නිරෝධෝ,
භව නිරෝධා ජාති නිරෝධෝ,  ජාති නිරෝධා ජරා මරණං,
roman: Avijjāyatvēva asēsa virāga nirodhā saṅkhāra nirodho,
Saṅkhāra nirodhā viññaṇa nirodho, Viññāṇa nirodhā nāma-
Nāma- rūpa nirodhā saḷāyatana nirodho, Saḷāyatana nirodhā
Phassa nirodhā vēdanā nirodho, Vēdanā nirodhā tanhā
Taṇhā nirodhā upādāna nirodho, Upādāna nirodhā bhava
Bhava nirodhā jāti nirodho, Jāti nirodhā jarā maraṇaṃ, soka
english: The complete cessation of ignorance leads to the cessation of volitional activities. The
cessation of volitional
activities lead to the cessation of consciousness. The cessation of consciousness leads to the
cessation of mind and matter.
The cessation of mind and matter leads to the cessation of six spheres of sense.
The cessation of six spheres of sense leads to the cessation of contact. The cessation of
contact leads to the cessation of sensation.
The cessation of sensation leads to the cessation of craving. The cessation of craving leads -
to the cessation of grasping. The cessation of grasping leads to the cessation of becoming.
The cessation of becoming -
leads to the cessation of birth. The cessation of birth leads to the cessation of decay, death,
sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief and despair. Thus, entire mass of suffering ceases.

lines.text: නිවැරදි පිළිසරණ යෑම
බහුං වේ සරණං යන්ති - පබ්බතානි වනානි ච
ආරාම රුක්ඛ චේත්‍යානි - මනුස්සා භය තජ්ජිතා
Bahuṃ ve saraṇaṃ yanti - pabbatāni vanāni ca
To many refuges they go, To mountain slopes and forest glades,
Ārāma rukkha cetyāni - manussā bhaya tajjitā
To parkland shrines and sacred sites,  People overcome by fear
නේතං ඛෝ සරණං ඛේමං - නේතං සරණමුත්තමං
නේතං සරණමාගම්ම - සබ්බ දුක්ඛා පමුච්චති
N’etaṃ kho saraṇaṃ khemaṃ - n’etaṃ saraṇamuttamaṃ
Such a refuge is not secure, such a refuge is not supreme,
N’etaṃ saraṇamāgamma - sabbadukkhā pamuccati
Such a refuge does not bring, Complete release from suffering.
යෝ ච බුද්ධං ච ධම්මං ච - සංඝං ච සරණං ගතෝ
චත්තාරි අරිය සච්චානි - සම්මප්පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
Yo ca Buddhañca Dhammañca - saṅghañca saraṇaṃ gato
Whoever goes to refuge, In the Triple Gem
Cattāri ariya-saccāni - sammappaññāya passati
Sees with right discernment, the Four Noble Truths:
දුක්ඛං දුක්ඛසමුප්පාදං - දුක්ඛස්ස ච අතික්කමං
අරියං චට්ඨංගිකං මග්ගං - දුක්ඛූපසමගාමිනං
Dukkhaṃ dukkha samuppādaṃ - dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ
Suffering and its origin, and that which lies beyond
Ariyañ c’aṭṭh’aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ - dukkhūpa samagāminaṃ
The Noble Eightfold Path, that leads the way to suffering’s end.

pali_si: බහුං වේ සරණං යන්ති - පබ්බතානි වනානි ච
ආරාම රුක්ඛ චේත්‍යානි - මනුස්සා භය තජ්ජිතා

To parkland shrines and sacred sites,  People overcome by fear

Sees with right discernment, the Four Noble Truths:

roman: Dukkhaṃ dukkha samuppādaṃ - dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ

The Noble Eightfold Path, that leads the way to suffering’s end.

lines.text: ඒතං ඛෝ සරණං ඛේමං - ඒතං සරණමුත්තමං
ඒතං සරණමාගම්ම - සබ්බ දුක්ඛා පමුච්චති
Etaṃ kho saraṇaṃ khemaṃ - etaṃ saraṇamuttamaṃ
Such a refuge is secure, such a refuge is supreme,
Etaṃ saraṇamāgamma - sabbadukkhā pamuccati
Such a refuge truly brings, complete release from all suffering.
තිලකුණු මෙනෙහි කිරීම
සබ්බේ සංඛාරා අනිච්චාති - යදා පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
‘Impermanent are all conditioned things’, when with wisdom this is seen
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā
One feels weary of all dukkha; this is the path to purity.
සබ්බේ සංඛාරා දුක්ඛාති - යදා පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
‘Dukkha are all conditioned things’, when with wisdom this is seen
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā
One feels weary of all dukkha; this is the path to purity.
සබ්බේ ධම්මා අනත්තාති - යදා පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
Sabbe dhammā anattā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
‘There is no self in anything’, when with wisdom this is seen
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā
One feels weary of all dukkha; this is the path to purity.

pali_si: ඒතං ඛෝ සරණං ඛේමං - ඒතං සරණමුත්තමං
roman: Etaṃ kho saraṇaṃ khemaṃ - etaṃ saraṇamuttamaṃ
english: Such a refuge is secure, such a refuge is supreme,
Such a refuge truly brings, complete release from all suffering.

pali_si: සබ්බේ සංඛාරා අනිච්චාති - යදා පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
roman: Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā

අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
roman: Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā

අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා
roman: Sabbe dhammā anattā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā
english: ‘There is no self in anything’, when with wisdom this is seen
One feels weary of all dukkha; this is the path to purity.

lines.text: අප්පකාතේ මනුස්සේසු - යේ ජනා පාරගාමිනෝ
අථායං ඉතරා පජා - තීරමේවානුධාවති
Appakā te manussesu - ye janā pāragāmino
Few amongst humankind, are those who go beyond,
Athāyaṃ itarā pajā - tīramevānudhāvati
Yet there are the many folks, ever wandering on this shore.
යේ ච ඛෝ සම්ම දක්ඛාතේ - ධම්මේ ධම්මානුවත්තිනෝ
තේ ජනා පාරමෙස්සන්ති - මච්චුධෙය්‍යං සුදුත්තරං
Ye ca kho sammadakkhāte - dhamme dhammānuvattino
Wherever Dhamma is well-taught, those who train in line with it
Te janā pāramessanti - maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ
Are the ones who will cross over, the realm of death so hard to flee.
කණ්හං ධම්මං විප්පහාය - සුක්කං භාවේථ පණ්ඩිතෝ
ඕකා අනෝකං ආගම්ම - විවේකේ යත්ථ දූරමං
තත්‍රාභිරති මිච්ඡෙය්‍ය - හිත්වා කාමේ අකිඤ්චනෝ
Kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ vippahāya - sukkaṃ bhāvetha paṇḍito
Abandoning the darker states, the wise pursue the bright;
Okā anokam āgamma - viveke yattha dūramaṃ
From the floods dry land, they reach, living withdrawn so hard to do.
Tatrābhirati miccheyya - hitvā kāme akiñcano
Such rare delight one should desire, sense pleasures cast away, not having anything.
මෛත්‍රී භාවනාව
අහං අවේරෝ හෝමි, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣෝ හෝමි, අනීඝෝ හෝමි
සුඛී අත්තානං පරිහරාමි.
Aham avēro homi, abyāpajjho homi, anīgho homi, sukhi
attānam pariharāmi.
May I be free from enmity and danger, May I be free from mental suffering, May I be free
from physical suffering. May I take care of myself happily.

roman: Appakā te manussesu - ye janā pāragāmino
english: Few amongst humankind, are those who go beyond,
Yet there are the many folks, ever wandering on this shore.

pali_si: යේ ච ඛෝ සම්ම දක්ඛාතේ - ධම්මේ ධම්මානුවත්තිනෝ
roman: Ye ca kho sammadakkhāte - dhamme dhammānuvattino
english: Wherever Dhamma is well-taught, those who train in line with it
Are the ones who will cross over, the realm of death so hard to flee.

pali_si: කණ්හං ධම්මං විප්පහාය - සුක්කං භාවේථ පණ්ඩිතෝ
ඕකා අනෝකං ආගම්ම - විවේකේ යත්ථ දූරමං
roman: Kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ vippahāya - sukkaṃ bhāvetha paṇḍito
Okā anokam āgamma - viveke yattha dūramaṃ
english: Abandoning the darker states, the wise pursue the bright;
From the floods dry land, they reach, living withdrawn so hard to do.
Such rare delight one should desire, sense pleasures cast away, not having anything.

pali_si: අහං අවේරෝ හෝමි, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣෝ හෝමි, අනීඝෝ හෝමි
roman: Aham avēro homi, abyāpajjho homi, anīgho homi, sukhi
english: May I be free from enmity and danger, May I be free from mental suffering, May I be free
from physical suffering. May I take care of myself happily.

lines.text: මම මාතා පිතූ, ආචරියා ච ඤාතිමිත්තා ච, සබ්‍රහ්මචාරිනෝ ච,
අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී
අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු.
Mama mātā pitu, ācariya ca ñātimitta ca, sabrahma cārino
ca, avēra hontu,
May my parents, teachers relatives and friends, fellow Dhamma farers, be free from enmity
and danger,
abyāpajjha hontu, anīgha hontu, sukhi attānam pariharantu.
be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, may they take care of
themselves happily.
ඉමස්මිං ආරාමේ සබ්බේ යෝගිනෝ,  අවේරා හොන්තු,
අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං
පරිහරන්තු.
Imasmim ārāme sabbe yogino, avēra hontu, abyāpajjha
hontu, anīgha hontu,
May all meditators in this compound, be free from enmity and danger, be free from mental
suffering,
sukhi attānam pariharantu.
be free from physical suffering, May they take care of themselves happily
ඉමස්මිං ආරාමේ, සබ්බේ භික්ඛු සාමණේරා ච, උපාසක
උපාසිකායෝ ච, අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු,
අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු.
Imasmim ārāme, sabbe bhikkhu sāmanēra ca, upāsaka
upāsikayo ca,
May all monks in this compound, novice monks, laymen and laywomen disciples, be free
from enmity
avēra hontu, abyāpajjha hontu, anīgha hontu, sukhi
attānam pariharantu.
and danger, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, May they take
care of themselves happily.
අම්හාකං චතුපච්චය දායකා අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා
